text_block_list.text: (Wham! Rattle rattle rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you okay?! You tumbled right off 
your chair at 10 mph, though."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Were you looking at this? The 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen race entry sheet...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, this is...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, she's the Umamusume Master is 
training.

text_block_list.text:
"The horse girl my master is training is 
running in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. 
Seeing her name took me by surprise, which 
led to that blunder earlier."

She's one generation older than Gran 
Alegria and has conquered numerous graded 
sprint races.

Without a doubt, she will be Gran 
Alegria's greatest rival in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... A master vs. student showdown 
right after graduating! It's like 
something out of a manga!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Still... Trainer-san, this is our chance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is our chance to show our 
resolve!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories! 
Along with everything learned and 
inherited!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let us show them a run that stands as the 
culmination of everything we've done!

"And then, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. My 
first face-to-face meeting with Master 
since the start of the year."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: It's been a while, hasn't it?
choice_data_list:
I felt we needed to draw a clear line this 
time

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I'm relieved you understand. We've come 
prepared for that as well.

The air ignited under that sharp gaze. I 
glared back with all my might so as not to 
be overwhelmed by the prickling, searing 
aura.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...The Umamusume trained by Gran-chan's 
"master" is running in this race too, 
isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'm about to face it... The 
baptism of GⅠ—from the older generation...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The difference in race experience compared 
to those girls who have pushed through 
grueling race after grueling race.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A single year's gap that was far too vast.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In the autumn of my Classic year, I was 
forced to learn that lesson painfully 
well...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—The older generation is overwhelmingly 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even when I challenged, I was repelled. 
Exhausted from fierce battles, it became 
difficult to even race—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All I could show to everyone who cheered 
for me was such a pathetic display.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to their cheers... Yet, 
I haven't been able to give back anything 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even standing on the turf feels daunting 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Gran-chan is okay...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Deeeep breath in...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(It's 0.75 miles today, so I need to make 
my move early.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Maaan, everyone's stares are really 
piercing through me. Looks like quite a 
few people might be marking me today.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (Well, sprint races are all about speed.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"To finish it off, blowing past everyone 
at 45 miles an hour. That's the only way, 
right?♪"
